cards.title: Material Handling in an Active Work Area
cards.situation: A worker enters an active material-handling area with potential falling objects, foot impact, and moving equipment.
cards.task: Identify the hazards and select PPE before entering.

cards.title: Grinding and Cutting Operation
cards.situation: A worker performs powered grinding or cutting that generates high-velocity particles, sparks, and exposure to sharp material.
cards.task: Identify the hazards and select PPE before starting.

cards.title: Chemical Handling and Transfer
cards.situation: A worker transfers liquid chemicals with potential splash exposure to the eyes, face, hands, and feet.
cards.task: Identify the hazards and select PPE before transferring.

cards.title: Industrial Machine Operation
cards.situation: A worker operates industrial machinery in a noisy work area with moving equipment nearby.
cards.task: Identify the hazards and select PPE before operating.

cards.title: Electrical Maintenance on an Energized Low-Voltage Panel
cards.situation: A maintenance worker inspects a low-voltage control panel that cannot yet be fully de-energized for diagnosis. Exposed energized components may be present, creating electrical contact and electrical-fault spark exposure.
cards.task: Identify the hazards and select PPE before inspection.

cards.title: Integrated Multi-Hazard Workplace
cards.situation: A maintenance worker is simultaneously exposed to falling objects, airborne particles, elevated noise, and moving equipment.
cards.task: Identify the hazards and select PPE before entering.

cards.title: Materials Route Inspection
cards.situation: On a loading lane, overhead materials may fall, carried items may strike a worker's feet, and mobile equipment continues to pass through the area.
cards.task: Identify the hazards and select PPE for the route.

cards.title: Powered Metal Trimming
cards.situation: Powered trimming of a metal section can send fast fragments and hot sparks outward while the worker handles sharp cut edges.
cards.task: Identify the hazards and select PPE for the cutting task.

cards.title: Liquid Chemical Decanting
cards.situation: While decanting a liquid chemical, a worker could be splashed on the eyes or face and have the liquid contact the hands or feet.
cards.task: Identify the hazards and select PPE for decanting.

cards.title: Machine-Line Check
cards.situation: A worker checks a running industrial machine while elevated noise continues and other equipment moves near the work area.
cards.task: Identify the hazards and select PPE for the check.

cards.title: Low-Voltage Panel Troubleshooting
cards.situation: Diagnostics require work at a low-voltage panel before full de-energization. Exposed energized parts could be contacted, and a fault may produce sparks or particles.
cards.task: Identify the hazards and select PPE before troubleshooting.

cards.title: Maintenance-Area Walkthrough
cards.situation: A worker crosses a maintenance area where objects may fall, airborne particles are present, machines create elevated noise, and equipment moves nearby.
cards.task: Identify the hazards and select PPE for the walkthrough.
